tools.name: refresh_company
tools.description:

get_refresh_status. Works for companies already in the index and for domains we
have never seen, which is how you add one.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "find_company" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_watches · Private data: search_companies, watch_company · Public sink: watch_company.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_watches · Private data: search_companies, watch_company · Public sink: watch_company

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
